question: Should this personal profile README replace its current text-oriented project list with live third-party `pinme` repository-card images?
rationale: The requested outcome is a subjective design choice and introduces an external hosted dependency; source review cannot determine the owner’s desired visual identity or acceptable reliability/privacy tradeoff.

options.title: Keep the curated text list
options.body: Retain the existing self-contained README presentation and avoid the additional hosted rendering dependency.

options.title: Adopt repository cards
options.body: Accept the proposed card-based presentation after confirming that the external service, accessibility, and long-term availability meet the owner’s standards.

options.title: Use a static alternative
options.body: Adopt richer visuals while committing static image assets or markup in-repository rather than loading a third-party card service at profile-render time.

recommendation.title: Keep the curated text list
recommendation.body: Retain the existing self-contained README presentation and avoid the additional hosted rendering dependency.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a personal-profile presentation and dependency decision for the repository owner.
